issues.detail: The Greek 'ο ποιων την αμαρτιαν εκ του διαβολου' describes the person who commits sin *from/out of* (ek tou) the devil. The Vietnamese 'Kẻ phạm tội là thuộc về ma quỷ' translates this as 'The sinner belongs to the devil,' which changes the grammatical relationship from an origin/source of the action to a state of belonging.
